cues.en: In this lesson you are going to learn about the modulus, which is also called the remainder after division.
cues.zh: 這堂課要學 modulus，也就是除法的餘數。

cues.en: Now if you're not really sure what the Modulus of a division is or what the modulo operator means then don't worry.
cues.zh: 如果不確定除法的 modulus 是什麼，或取餘數運算子的意思，別擔心，

cues.en: It's a simple concept.
cues.zh: 概念很簡單，

cues.en: I'm going to explain it in the next slide.
cues.zh: 下一張投影片會解釋。

cues.en: Also in this video you are going to learn one of the main applications of the modulus, which is to determine whether a number is odd or even.
cues.zh: 也會學到取餘數的一個主要用途：判斷數字是奇數還是偶數。

cues.en: So of course the odd numbers are like 1 3 5 7.
cues.zh: 奇數當然像是 1、3、5、7，

cues.en: And even numbers are like 2 4 6 and 8.
All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So if you would divide ten by three then you might get an answer that looks something like this.
cues.zh: 10 除以 3，可能會寫成這樣的答案，

cues.en: It's 3 with a remainder of 1.
So 3 is for...
cues.zh: 這個 3 是，

cues.en: we could call this integer division.
cues.zh: 可以稱為整數除法的結果，

cues.en: So 3 goes into 10 3 times -- not exactly three times, but that is the integer number of times that 3 goes into 10.
cues.zh: 也就是 10 裡可以放三個 3，不是剛好三個，但整數部分是三次。

cues.en: But because 3 doesn't go into 10 exactly 3 times then we have a little bit left over and that is called
cues.zh: 因為三個 3 不剛好等於 10，所以還剩下一點，這就叫，

cues.en: the remainder, which is also called the modulus. So the modulo operator in python I will show it to you
cues.zh: 餘數，也稱為 modulus。Python 的取餘數運算子，等一下會示範，

cues.en: in a moment but basically the modulus in Python is going to be this number here -- not this number,
cues.zh: 基本上會得到這個數字，不是這個，

cues.en: this is the integer division -- but instead we will get this number out of Python All right.
cues.zh: 這是整數除法的部分，而是從 Python 得到這個餘數。好。

cues.en: So let's switch to Python and I'll show you how to compute the modulus so I'm going to begin by creating some numbers.
cues.zh: 切到 Python，示範怎麼算餘數。先建立幾個數字。

cues.en: So a equals 10 and b equals 3.
These are of course the same numbers that I just showed in the slide so I can do regular division by saying a divided by B.
cues.zh: 就是投影片裡的數字。一般除法可以寫 a 除以 b。

cues.en: Now in this case Python is not going to return 3 remainder 1.
cues.zh: 這時 Python 不會傳回「3 餘 1」，

cues.en: Python is going to show this in decimal format up to whatever precision it has for the output.
cues.zh: 而會以小數格式顯示，位數取決於輸出的精確度。

cues.en: So 3 goes into 10 3 point 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3.
Now in theory this this these 3 is go on forever.
cues.zh: 理論上，這些 3 會無限延伸，

cues.en: But here python is truncating and rounding this off to 5.
cues.zh: 但這裡 Python 截取、四捨五入，最後一位成為 5。

cues.en: Okay so this shows division and now I'm going to show you integer division. So integer division,
cues.zh: 好，這是除法，接著示範整數除法。

cues.en: and here we just use the function int so the function int is going to extract an integer out of whatever is the input.
cues.zh: 使用 int 函數，從輸入值取出整數。

cues.en: So the input into this int function is three and one third approximately so three point three three three.
cues.zh: int 的輸入，約是三又三分之一，也就是 3.333，

cues.en: And what Python is going to return is the number three.
cues.zh: Python 會傳回數字 3，

cues.en: So that's the integer.
cues.zh: 這就是整數部分。

cues.en: Now I want to show you something else, which is how to get more information about a function.
cues.zh: 還想示範，怎麼取得函數的更多資訊。

cues.en: So if you're not totally sure how this function int works, then of course you could open up a web browser and search in Google for this function.
cues.zh: 如果不確定 int 怎麼運作，當然可以開瀏覽器，用 Google 搜尋，

cues.en: But there's also an easier way to do it, which is to get the help file for this function.
cues.zh: 但也有更簡單的方法，就是查看函數的說明文件。

cues.en: And the easiest way to do that is to click so you're inside the function, so inside the parentheses here, and then you press on your keyboard shift
cues.zh: 最簡單的做法，是點進函數，也就是括號內，再按 Shift，

cues.en: and then tab. And that's going to open up this little window here that tells you a little bit about the function and you can press the plus sign and that will give you more information about it.
cues.zh: 加 Tab。這會開啟小視窗，簡單介紹函數。再按加號，就能看到更多資訊。

cues.en: Sometimes you also see some examples. Now, when looking through these help files, you will often see
cues.zh: 有時也有範例。查看說明文件時，通常會發現，

cues.en: that there is more information than what you probably need for whatever you're looking for.
cues.zh: 裡面有不少資訊，超出你目前需要的範圍。

cues.en: So you have to have a little bit of patience to be able to look through these help files and figure out something that you're looking for.
cues.zh: 所以要稍微有耐心，仔細閱讀，找出自己需要的內容。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So now we know how to get integer division and now what we want is the remainder.
cues.zh: 現在知道如何取得整數除法的結果，接著要取得餘數。

cues.en: And I'm going to open up a new cell for this. So the remainder, the modulus operator, is the percent sign.
cues.zh: 新增一個儲存格。取餘數的運算子，是百分比符號。

cues.en: So I'm going to type a percent B.
cues.zh: 輸入 a%b。

cues.en: And now the answer is 1 and this answer is 1 because 3 goes into 10 3 times with the remainder of 1.
cues.zh: 答案是 1，因為 10 裡能放三個 3，餘下 1。

cues.en: And that's what this is telling us.
cues.zh: 這就是它告訴我們的事。

cues.en: So now I'd like to spend a moment showing you a little bit more code, which is actually mostly a review of integrating this into some nicer printing.
cues.zh: 接著多寫一點程式，主要是複習，把這個功能結合漂亮的輸出格式。

cues.en: So let's say... I'm going to say the division is the int of a divided by B, and then we have the remainder
cues.zh: 例如，把除法結果設成 int(a/b)，再來是餘數，

cues.en: and that is going to be a percent B or a modulus B.
cues.zh: 也就是 a%b，a 對 b 取餘數。

cues.en: Now I want to say print... and now basically I just want to print out this information.
cues.zh: 接著呼叫 print，基本上就是印出這些資訊。

cues.en: I want to say three goes into 10 three times with a remainder of 1.
cues.zh: 想顯示「10 裡可以放三個 3，餘數是 1」。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Now of course this is all hard-coded for the numbers 3 and 10, which is generally not a good idea.
cues.zh: 當然，這裡把 3 和 10 全部寫死了，通常不是好做法。

cues.en: This is not a scalable solution.
cues.zh: 這個做法無法靈活擴充。

cues.en: As soon as I change one of these numbers this is going to be incorrect, but as I've mentioned before when printing out like this I generally find it useful to print out what I want first and then I go
cues.zh: 只要改變其中一個數字，訊息就不正確了。但之前說過，這樣輸出時，我喜歡先把想顯示的內容寫下來，再，

cues.en: back and start editing.
cues.zh: 回頭修改。

cues.en: So now I'm going to replace all these numbers with percent G.
cues.zh: 把這些數字全部換成 %g。

cues.en: So percent G.
Percent G.
And then another percent G here. And now percent and then parentheses and now we can figure out what
cues.zh: 這裡再放一個 %g，接著百分比符號和括號，再想想，

cues.en: we need to replace these percent g's with. The first one is going to be B and then a.
cues.zh: 要用什麼取代這些 %g。第一個是 b，再來 a。

cues.en: So it's not a and then B because of the way I've written this so it's 3 is going into 10 not 10 is going into 3.
cues.zh: 不是先 a 再 b，因為這裡的句子是 10 裡放 3，不是 3 裡放 10。

cues.en: So b comma a.
cues.zh: 所以寫 b,a。

cues.en: And then we have to say the number of times the integer number of times that's this variable.
cues.zh: 再來是整數次數，也就是這個變數，

cues.en: divis. And then finally the remainder of the variable remainder.
cues.zh: divis，最後是餘數變數 remainder。

cues.en: So let's try this.
cues.zh: 試試看。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Three goes into 10.
cues.zh: 10 裡可以放 3，

cues.en: Three times with the remainder of 1.
cues.zh: 三次，餘數是 1。

cues.en: Now I'd like to test this a few more times.
cues.zh: 我想再多測幾次。

cues.en: I'm going to paste in these variables here.
cues.zh: 把這些變數貼在這裡，

cues.en: So let's try... you know, a good idea I think is also to try three.
cues.zh: 試試 3，

cues.en: oops, I mean nine.
cues.zh: 哎，應該是 9。

cues.en: So now we should get a remainder of zero which we do.
cues.zh: 現在預期餘數是 0，確實如此。

cues.en: So three goes into nine three times with the remainder of zero. We can try, you know eleven maybe so then we get three times with the remainder of two.
cues.zh: 9 裡能放三個 3，餘數是 0。也能試 11，得到三次，餘數是 2。

cues.en: And now let's try something you know some really large number, I have no idea what this is going to be
cues.zh: 接著試一些很大的數字，我完全不知道結果會是什麼，

cues.en: but it turns out that this number goes into this number three hundred and eighteen times with a remainder
cues.zh: 結果這個數字，能放進另一個數字 318 次，餘數，

cues.en: of thirty three thousand and twenty six. So whatever that means.
cues.zh: 是 33026。總之就是這樣。

cues.en: Now for the exercise of this video. This is actually a really important exercise because this shows you
cues.zh: 接著是這段影片的練習。這個練習很重要，因為會示範，

cues.en: what is, I think in my experience, the most important and commonly used application of the modulus operator,
cues.zh: 依我的經驗，取餘數運算子最重要、最常用的用途，

cues.en: which is to determine whether a number whether an integer is odd or even.
cues.zh: 也就是判斷一個數字、一個整數，是奇數還是偶數。

cues.en: So what you want to do in this exercise is loop through integers from minus five to plus five and report
cues.zh: 用迴圈走訪 -5 到正 5 的整數，回報，

cues.en: whether each number is an odd number or an even number. By the way, in case you never noticed the word
cues.zh: 每個是奇數還是偶數。順帶一提，如果你沒注意過，英文的，

cues.en: even has an even number of letters and the word odd has an odd number of letters. I'm not sure if that's coincidence or by design.
cues.zh: even 有偶數個字母，odd 有奇數個字母。不知道是巧合，還是刻意安排的。

cues.en: And once you finish programming this exercise, if you like there are two optional little bonus additions that you can do.
cues.zh: 完成程式後，也能做兩個選做的小加分項目。

cues.en: One is to make sure that the word number here is perfectly vertically aligned, so you can see even though there is an extra space in here.
cues.zh: 第一個是，讓 number 這個字完美地垂直對齊，這裡雖然多一個空白，

cues.en: But I wanted that number to be aligned here.
cues.zh: 但我希望 number 在這裡對齊。

cues.en: A second optional bonus.
cues.zh: 第二個選做加分項目，

cues.en: This one is pretty easy.
cues.zh: 前面這個很簡單，

cues.en: The second optional bonus which is a little bit more challenging is to figure out a way to get these
cues.zh: 第二個稍微難一點：想辦法讓這些，

cues.en: integers aligned here, independent of the minus sign. So you can see these numbers are all aligned and the minus sign comes to the left of these numbers.
cues.zh: 整數不受負號影響，彼此對齊。你可以看到數字對齊，負號在它們左邊。

cues.en: All right but this part is optional.
cues.zh: 不過，這部分是選做，

cues.en: This is just visualization formatting.
cues.zh: 只是視覺排版，

cues.en: That's not so important.
cues.zh: 不是那麼重要。

cues.en: The important part is to make sure you know how to test whether a number is odd or even. So, pause the video, switch to Python, work through this problem on your own.
cues.zh: 重點是，確定知道如何判斷奇偶數。請暫停影片，切換到 Python，自己試著解題。

cues.en: And then when you're finished you can come back and watch me work through a solution.
cues.zh: 完成後再回來，看我的解法。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So let's give ourselves a new cell down here. First I'm going to define a range of numbers let's call this num.
cues.zh: 在下面新增儲存格。先定義一段數字範圍，叫 nums。

cues.en: And I'm going to say range minus five to plus six and I've mentioned this before but I'll say it again
cues.zh: 寫 range(-5,6)。之前提過，再說一次，

cues.en: that it can be a little bit confusing because the number that you want Python to stop counting is actually one less than the second input into the range function.
cues.zh: 可能有點混淆：Python 最後數到的數字，是 range 第二個輸入減 1。

cues.en: So now we need a for loop to loop over all of these numbers. So say four and I'll just call this I for simplicity for nums.
cues.zh: 接著用 for 迴圈走訪全部數字。為了簡單，就用 i，走訪 nums。

cues.en: Don't forget the all important colon here. And then basically we want to immediately test and report.
cues.zh: 別忘了非常重要的冒號。基本上，接著要立刻測試並回報。

cues.en: So I'm going to say if I know how do we set this up.
cues.zh: 寫 if i，要怎麼設定呢？

cues.en: So I is going to be this number in here.
cues.zh: i 會是這裡的某個數字，

cues.en: We can use a division by 2.
cues.zh: 可以用除以 2，

cues.en: And now the idea is that if a number is divisible by 2 with 0 remainder, then it must be an even number.
cues.zh: 概念是，如果一個數字除以 2，餘數為 0，它一定是偶數。

cues.en: And if you divide a number by two and there is a remainder then it's going to be an odd number.
cues.zh: 如果除以 2 有餘數，就是奇數。

cues.en: So I'm going to say if I modulo two or percent two equals zero then I have to print and then this is going
cues.zh: 所以寫 if i%2==0，再用 print，

cues.en: to say let's say you know three is an even number then of course I need to replace three with percent
cues.zh: 顯示例如「3 是偶數」。當然，要把 3 換成 %，

cues.en: G and then I need to say percent i.
cues.zh: g，再寫 % i。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Now I am not yet finished with this exercise.
cues.zh: 練習還沒做完，

cues.en: However, I think it's a good idea to run through this already just to check that the code works so far.
cues.zh: 但我認為可以先執行，檢查目前的程式能否正常運作。

cues.en: So what we should see is minus 4 2 0 2 and 4.
These are all even numbers now.
cues.zh: 這些都是偶數。

cues.en: I suppose it's debatable whether 0 is an even or an odd number. It's a bit of a weird exception, but let's ignore that for the moment.
cues.zh: 我想，0 是奇數還是偶數，也許有討論空間，是個奇怪的例外，但暫時先不管。

cues.en: Technically, it does fit into our criteria here, which is that 2 goes into 0 0 times with the remainder of 0.
cues.zh: 技術上，它符合這裡的條件：0 裡能放零個 2，餘數是 0。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So so far this part is accurate.
cues.zh: 目前這部分正確。

cues.en: And now we need to print out that the number is odd if it doesn't fit this criteria and so I'm going to say, else
cues.zh: 如果不符合條件，就要印出這個數字是奇數，所以寫 else，

cues.en: again a colon here and then we print and then this is basically going to be really similar.
cues.zh: 一樣加冒號，再用 print，內容基本上類似。

cues.en: So I'm going to say percent G is an odd number and then percent I.
cues.zh: 寫「%g 是奇數」，再接 % i。

cues.en: So we are getting that -- in fact this is now finished the like mandatory part of the exercise. But there's still a few more things I would like to add.
cues.zh: 已經得到結果，其實練習的必做部分完成了，但我還想加一些東西。

cues.en: So one thing is that the number doesn't line up here and that part is easy to fix.
cues.zh: 首先，number 這個字沒有對齊，很容易修正。

cues.zh: 只要在這裡多加一個空白。

cues.en: OK.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So now we see the number.
cues.zh: 現在看到 number，

cues.en: The word number lines up here, the word number lines up here.
cues.zh: 這裡的 number 對齊了，這裡也對齊了。

cues.en: And what we're missing is the alignment on the numbers over here.
cues.zh: 還差這邊的數字對齊。

cues.en: Now this isn't really wrong the way that it's printed out, because python is aligning everything to the first character, which is a minus sign here.
cues.zh: 目前這樣輸出並沒有錯，因為 Python 對齊的是第一個字元，這裡是負號，

cues.en: And the actual number here.
cues.zh: 這裡則是數字本身。

cues.en: But I think it would look nicer if we could align this according to the integer.
cues.zh: 但如果依整數位置對齊，會更好看。

cues.en: And so basically what we need to do is add a space onto these positive numbers or at least these non negative numbers.
cues.zh: 基本上，要在正數，至少是非負數前面，加上一個空白。

cues.en: Now there's a couple of ways you could have solved that. The way that I'm going to solve this is by creating something called firstchar.
cues.zh: 有幾種解法。我會建立一個叫 firstchar 的東西。

cues.en: Let's create a new variable called firstchar and I'll set it equal to a space.
cues.zh: 新增變數 firstchar，設成一個空白，

cues.en: So it's just going to be a space in here like this.
cues.zh: 就是裡面一個空白。

cues.en: And now I want to add this firstchar in here before this number.
cues.zh: 再把 firstchar 加在這個數字前面。

cues.en: Now this is a string.
cues.zh: 這是字串，

cues.en: This is not an integer.
cues.zh: 不是整數，

cues.en: This is not a number.
cues.zh: 不是數值。

cues.zh: 因此，把 firstchar 加進去時，不用 %g，而是 %s。%g 用來印數字，%

cues.en: S is for printing out strings.
cues.zh: s 則用來印字串。

cues.en: And so I'll put that here as well.
cues.zh: 這裡也加上。

cues.en: And now we need to have two options in here, two replacements. So I need to add parentheses here so it
cues.zh: 現在有兩個項目要替換，所以需要括號，

cues.en: is going to say firstchar and then I add another closing parenthesis here.
cues.zh: 先放 firstchar，再在這裡加上右括號。

cues.zh: 好。

cues.zh: 訊息說，格式字串的引數不足。

cues.en: So here we say we want a string format and there are not enough arguments.
cues.zh: 這裡要求字串格式化，但引數不夠，

cues.en: That's referring to this fact here we're missing something here.
cues.zh: 指的就是這裡少了一個項目。

cues.en: So now I'm also going to try firstchar.
cues.zh: 我也在這裡試著放 firstchar，

cues.en: So it looks like this but there's no parentheses around it.
cues.zh: 像這樣，但外面沒有括號。

cues.en: And we still get an error so we need to add parentheses in here like this.
cues.zh: 仍然出錯，所以要像這樣加括號。

cues.en: OK.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: But in fact we haven't really solve the problem.
cues.zh: 但其實還沒解決問題，

cues.en: All we've done is put a space in front of everything.
